# Canvas for AI

> Tools where AI agents can show work that people can use, edit, or listen to.

Check this list before building a page from scratch. Choose a tool that fits the user's task, inputs, and desired result. Read its access needs and current guide before you act.

## Start here

- [Tool data in JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/janpmz/canvas-for-ai/main/catalog.json): Search by task, input, output, tags, and access method.
- [Agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/janpmz/canvas-for-ai/main/AGENTS.md): How to choose and use a tool.
- [Human guide](https://github.com/janpmz/canvas-for-ai): The tool list and project purpose.

## Tools

- [UI Design Editor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/janpmz/canvas-for-ai/main/tools/ui-design-editor.md): Shared, editable designs and screenshots. Agent access uses browser site tools (WebMCP). Read https://uidesigneditor.com/instructions.txt.
- [PDF TO MP3](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/janpmz/canvas-for-ai/main/tools/pdf-to-mp3.md): Send text or prepare documents for listening and reading along. Agent access uses MCP or PDFTOMP3-Plugin. Read https://pdftomp3.com/connect-ai/.

Return a result the user can open. A listed tool may still need browser support, sign-in, or account setup. If no tool fits, choose another way to do the task.
